verdict.rationale: Buzz's own materials say it can search history: agents search six months of it, and users can search conversations, patches, workflow runs and approvals in one place. Nothing documents admin-scoped search over the full history, and no filters by sender, channel or date are mentioned. The 'six months' wording also hints the history searched may not be complete. Missing for 10: documented sender/channel/date filters, a team-admin search interface or command, evidence of full-history coverage, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can search the full message history with filters like sender, channel, and date

citations.quote: Search the conversation, the patch, the workflow run, and the approval in one place
Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
